liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Here Comes Sunshine** (5 reviews): The jam into China Cat Sunflower and I Know You Rider was highlighted; The jam into China Cat Sunflower and I Know You Rider cemented the reviewer's love [5][9][10][11][13]
- **He's Gone** (1 review): Getting this song so early in the show was a treat for the listener [14]
- **Looks Like Rain** (1 review): Bobby's voice was very strong on this track and later on Me & Bobby McGee [14]
- **Loose Lucy** (1 review): The performance of this song still needed a bit of work according to the listener [10]
- **They Love Each Other** (1 review): The early versions of this song featured a funky beat that the reviewer liked [10]
- **Row Jimmy** (1 review): The performance was noted for a more upbeat version of this track [5]

## The recordings

- **gd1973-02-17.sbd.ashley-field.32875.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 29 songs; 185 min; rated 4.71/5 by 7 [1]
- **gd1973-02-17.163792.sbd.fixed.miller.flac1648**: soundboard; 28 songs; 185 min; rated 5/5 by 3 [2]
- **gd1973-02-17.sbd.miller.32580.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 28 songs; 185 min; rated 4.38/5 by 13 [3]
- **gd1973-02-17.150300.sbd.miller.flac1648**: soundboard; 28 songs; 185 min; rated 4/5 by 5 [4]

## Around the show

- The band struggled with mysterious PA anomalies before the sound crew got used to the venue [6]
- The reviewer attended a show ten days earlier at Maples and another at Kezar [6]
- The band had only one drummer, which the reviewer preferred over later configurations [13]
- The reviewer had worn out their tape of the Dane Coliseum show previously [14]
- Numerous technical problems occurred in the first set, including an epic one during Looks Like Rain [15]
- Tape cuts were present throughout the show according to the listener [15]
- Phil and Donna had a strong performance on Box of Rain [16]
- The show is not fair to compare with the February 15, 1973 performance in audio or selection [16]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1973-02-17.sbd.ashley-field.32875.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Jay Ashley and Gary Field; source: Bertha Remaster of multi-signature source (shn id 32580) [1]. Also: Digitally remastered by an archive.org user in March 2006 from sources with distinct spectral signatures; A 16khz spike in two sources is likely due to CRT Horizontal EMI during recording [1]
- **gd1973-02-17.163792.sbd.fixed.miller.flac1648**: transferred by All Transfers and Mastering by Charlie Miller  February 23, 2023; source: SBD > Reel Master (7.5ips 1/2trk) > Reel/1 (7.5ips/Dolby B) > DAT/0 (Panasonic SV-3800/48k) [2]. Also: Most tunings were edited out, and the mix in Promised Land and He's Gone is a mess; Stella Blue is cut at the end and the beginning of Truckin' is cut [2]
- **gd1973-02-17.sbd.miller.32580.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Reel -> PCM -> Dat -> CD D [3]. Also: The reviewer specifically enjoyed the Charlie Miller mix of this recording; Bird Song, Beat It On Down The Line, Loose Lucy, Me And Bobby McGee, and Stella Blue are patched from SBD to cassette to CD; Some pops and level problems were fixed using Cool Edit Pro v2.0 [3][11]
- **gd1973-02-17.150300.sbd.miller.flac1648**: transferred by All Transfers and Mastering by Charlie Miller  June 26, 2020; source: SBD > Reel Master (7.5ips 1/2trk) > Reel/1 (7.5ips/Dolby B) > DAT/0 (Panasonic SV-3800/48k) [4]. Also: Beat It On Down The Line and Me And Bobby McGee are supplied from SBD to cassette sources [4]
